about: M6 段3 の評価の、作った SI。base は pdf-cases.json の件（図は段2 と同じ png・crop、①は段2 の記録を流し直す）。番号の無い図（lab）は、番号で段落を探せないので入れない。products は図の生成物の番号ごとの系統名（name、手元の OPSIN で正解の構造に戻ることを確かめる）と、置換の位置などを変えた名前（wrong、「名前の食い違い」の版で使う）と、SI の手順に書く条件。conflict は「食い違い」の版で変える項目と、SI に書く値（収率は {yield} を差し替え、温度は find を replace に置き換える）。図（①）にその値が無い件は食い違いを見つけようがないので null

products.name: methyl 2-[[(2S)-2-[(tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino]propanoyl]amino]acetate
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.89 g, 10.0 mmol) and 2 (1.38 g, 11.0 mmol) in DMF (40 mL) were added HATU (4.56 g, 12.0 mmol, 1.2 equiv) and DIPEA (5.2 mL, 30 mmol, 3 equiv). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 2 h, diluted with EtOAc and washed with brine.
products.result: Purification by column chromatography gave 3 (2.21 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: 4-(benzyloxy)benzaldehyde
products.procedure: A mixture of 1 (1.22 g, 10.0 mmol), 2 (1.31 mL, 11.0 mmol) and K2CO3 (2.76 g, 20.0 mmol) in DMF (30 mL) was stirred at 60 °C for 4 h. After cooling, water was added and the product was extracted with Et2O.
products.result: Recrystallization gave 3 (1.91 g, {yield}%) as colorless needles.

products.name: methyl (2S)-2-[(tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino]-3-phenylpropanoate
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.79 g, 10.0 mmol) and Et3N (2.8 mL, 20 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (30 mL) at 0 °C was added Boc2O (2.40 g, 11.0 mmol). The mixture was warmed to room temperature and stirred for 12 h.
products.result: The residue was purified by flash chromatography to give 2 (2.57 g, {yield}%) as a colorless oil.

products.name: methyl (2S)-2-[(tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino]-3-phenylpropanoate
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.79 g, 10.0 mmol) and Et3N (2.8 mL, 20 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (30 mL) at 0 °C was added Boc2O (2.40 g, 11.0 mmol). The mixture was warmed to room temperature and stirred for 12 h.
products.result: The residue was purified by flash chromatography to give 2 (2.57 g, {yield}%) as a colorless oil.

products.name: piperidin-4-ylmethanol
products.procedure: Compound 1 (2.15 g, 10.0 mmol) was dissolved in CH2Cl2 (20 mL) and TFA (10 mL) was added at 0 °C. The solution was stirred at room temperature for 1 h and concentrated.
products.result: The residue was passed through a basic resin to give 2 (1.09 g, {yield}%) as a pale yellow oil.

products.name: 4-(4-methylphenyl)morpholine
products.procedure: An oven-dried tube was charged with Pd2(dba)3 (92 mg, 0.10 mmol), XPhos (190 mg, 0.40 mmol) and NaOtBu (1.35 g, 14.0 mmol). Toluene (20 mL), 1 (1.27 g, 10.0 mmol) and 2 (1.05 mL, 12.0 mmol) were added and the mixture was heated at 100 °C for 16 h.
products.result: Filtration through Celite and chromatography gave 3 (1.56 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: 1-benzyl-4-phenyl-1H-1,2,3-triazole
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.33 g, 10.0 mmol) and 2 (1.12 g, 11.0 mmol) in t-BuOH/H2O (1:1, 40 mL) were added CuSO4·5H2O (125 mg, 0.50 mmol) and sodium ascorbate (396 mg, 2.0 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 18 h.
products.result: The precipitate was collected by filtration to give 3 (2.12 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: 3-(1-methyl-1H-pyrrol-2-yl)cyclohexan-1-one
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (0.96 g, 10.0 mmol) and 2 (1.62 g, 20.0 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (20 mL) at −20 °C was added the imidazolidinone catalyst (0.20 equiv) and TFA (0.20 equiv). The mixture was stirred at −20 °C for 24 h.
products.result: Chromatography gave 3 (1.38 g, {yield}%) as a yellow oil.

products.name: 4-nitrobenzoic acid
products.procedure: A solution of 1 (1.81 g, 10.0 mmol) and LiOH (0.48 g, 20.0 mmol) in THF/H2O (3:1, 40 mL) was stirred at room temperature for 3 h, then acidified with 1 M HCl.
products.result: The precipitate was collected to give 2 (1.59 g, {yield}%) as a pale yellow solid.

products.name: 1-phenylethan-1-ol
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.06 g, 10.0 mmol) in THF (30 mL) at 0 °C was added MeMgBr (3.0 M in Et2O, 4.0 mL, 12.0 mmol) dropwise. The mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 30 min and quenched with saturated aqueous NH4Cl.
products.result: Distillation gave 2 (1.07 g, {yield}%) as a colorless liquid.

products.name: (1S)-1-phenylethyl 4-nitrobenzoate
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.22 g, 10.0 mmol), 2 (2.00 g, 12.0 mmol) and PPh3 (3.15 g, 12.0 mmol) in THF (40 mL) at 0 °C was added DIAD (2.4 mL, 12.0 mmol) dropwise. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 6 h.
products.result: Chromatography gave 3 (2.06 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: 4-methoxyaniline
products.procedure: A suspension of 1 (1.53 g, 10.0 mmol) and 10% Pd/C (150 mg) in MeOH (30 mL) was stirred under H2 (1 atm) at room temperature for 5 h and filtered through Celite.
products.result: Concentration gave 2 (1.17 g, {yield}%) as a brown solid.

products.name: 4-benzylmorpholine
products.procedure: To a solution of 1 (1.06 g, 10.0 mmol) and 2 (0.96 mL, 11.0 mmol) in 1,2-dichloroethane (40 mL) was added NaBH(OAc)3 (2.97 g, 14.0 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 8 h and quenched with saturated aqueous NaHCO3.
products.result: Chromatography gave 3 (1.56 g, {yield}%) as a colorless oil.

products.name: methyl 4-bromobenzoate
products.procedure: A solution of 1 (2.01 g, 10.0 mmol) in MeOH (40 mL) containing concentrated H2SO4 (0.5 mL) was heated at reflux for 12 h.
products.result: Workup gave 2 (2.04 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: methyl 4-(pyridin-3-yl)benzoate
products.procedure: A mixture of 2 (2.15 g, 10.0 mmol), 3 (1.48 g, 12.0 mmol), Pd(dppf)Cl2 (366 mg, 0.50 mmol) and Na2CO3 (2.12 g, 20.0 mmol) in dioxane/H2O (4:1, 50 mL) was heated at 90 °C for 8 h.
products.result: Chromatography gave 4 (1.75 g, {yield}%) as an off-white solid.

products.name: [4-(pyridin-3-yl)phenyl]methanol
products.procedure: To a suspension of LiAlH4 (0.57 g, 15.0 mmol) in THF (30 mL) at 0 °C was added a solution of 4 (2.13 g, 10.0 mmol) in THF (10 mL). The mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 1 h and quenched by the Fieser method.
products.result: Filtration and concentration gave 5 (1.68 g, {yield}%) as a white solid.

products.name: methylidenecyclohexane
products.procedure: To a suspension of methyltriphenylphosphonium bromide (4.29 g, 12.0 mmol) in THF (40 mL) at 0 °C was added n-BuLi (2.5 M, 4.8 mL, 12.0 mmol). After 30 min, 1 (0.98 g, 10.0 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 3 h.
products.result: Careful distillation gave 2 (0.71 g, {yield}%) as a colorless liquid.
